name: Assets
description: Items of value that a business owns. Examples include cash, inventory, and equipment.

name: Liabilities
description: Debts or money the business owes to others. Examples include loans and accounts payable.

name: Equity
description: The owner's remaining stake after subtracting debts from assets. Examples include stock and retained earnings.

name: Revenues
description: Money made from selling goods or services. Examples include sales revenue and service fees.

name: Expenses
description: Costs paid to run the business. Examples include rent, utilities, and payroll.
